title: Safe extensible shell contract
summary: Typed provider-owned bindings and versioned shell capabilities let configuration select admitted composition without executable project adapters.
invariants: Project configuration selects registered IDs and data only.
Binding-owned props cannot be supplied by static project configuration.
One Smart Gateway, LayoutComposer and PageBuilder serve build and preview.
A zero content gap preserves normal block flow and native Markdown margin collapsing; only an explicit non-zero gap opts into a flex column stack.
The published Docara shell remains visible while Framework becomes ready, and static navigation text is never interpreted as dynamic utility usage.

The common SIMAI Framework production Asset Planner analyses final body HTML through the existing Loader rule registry, emits exact content-hashed first-frame CSS and truthful SF_PRELOADED state, while no-build and late-DOM content retain the dynamic Loader path.

An optimized production page has its own hash-bound asset receipt and does not load utility.full.css; Docara owns only its layout CSS and consumes the shared Framework plan without a manual component list.
Header height remains natural: first-paint stability comes from blocking exact shell CSS and geometry-compatible fallback markup, not a fixed height or a global skeleton.
Projected Inter and active Material Symbols fonts start before first paint, and fenced code has a server-rendered language header with the same geometry as the interactive highlighter.
The full documentation tree is hydrated into the mobile sheet only when that sheet is first opened.
The default shell keeps the same topology and admitted presentation IDs unless a presentation is explicitly selected; verified bug fixes may change generated bytes.
